# Getting help

- **Something broke, or data is wrong:** open an [issue](https://github.com/sriinnu/kosha-discovery/issues/new/choose) and pick the matching template. Run `kosha doctor` first; it explains most credential and provider problems on its own.
- **Questions, "which model should I use", ideas:** [Discussions](https://github.com/sriinnu/kosha-discovery/discussions).
- **Security issues:** report privately, as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never in a public issue.
- **Docs:** [README](../README.md), [`docs/`](../docs), and the [wiki](https://github.com/sriinnu/kosha-discovery/wiki).

kosha is maintained by one person, so replies can take a few days.
